stage_probability.definition: P(Alt B | S1): permissionless/consensus-network AI reaches >=25% of AI workload (tokens) while its quality-adjusted price is below the closed providers', before automation reaches 50% of professional task categories, within 2026-2060. ci = bootstrap MC error only; structural_range = min/max across defensible specification variants (excludes threshold changes), which is the honest uncertainty band.

timeline.definition: Calendar year Alt B condition first met, among successful draws (few draws).

alt_B_extra.W_definition: W = permissionless + self-hosted/off-top-N open-weight share of workload (tokens).

probability.definition: P(Alt A | S2, not Alt B): parallel economy reaches >=10% of population by 2055 and is still >=5% ten years later without being suppressed below 5%, given m7's no-customers condition (uncompensated excluded share >=25% for 2 years by 2060) and no Alt B. Medium-term survival only; the public's fate under S5 is not modelled here.

in_model_timelines.note: m7's S2 is a simplified conditioning device; use m2 for P(S2).

interactions.B_effect_on_S3: Uncoopted B competes away provider markups (averts S3) and weakens S4 rentier logic by lowering AI-firm tax dominance. It does NOT cap S2: cheap AI accelerates automation, and network rewards replace only a small share of lost wages (see network_income_replacement). Integrator: in B draws treat S3 as averted with prob 1 - p_coopt (~0.65), S2 unchanged.
interactions.S2_note: Do not pass m7's P(S2_m7) to the integrator; m2 is canonical (m2 P(S2)=0.154 on a stricter consumption-based definition).

samples.note: 5000 random draws; B and A are per-draw binary outcomes; years null if not reached.

t50_years.source: Years from 2026 to A=0.5. ESPAI 2023 (Grace et al. 2024) HLMI 50% by 2047; Metaculus AGI ~2033; plus adoption lag (Comin & Hobijn 2010). Median 2039, p10~2033, p90~2052.

A0.source: Realised automation share late 2026 (Anthropic Economic Index; Eloundou 2023).

A_cap_plateau.source: Automation ceiling if plateau; judgement (Eloundou et al. 2023).

fb_A.source: Automation-speed response per unit uncompensated exclusion: negative = firms with no customers stop investing, positive = revenue pressure accelerates. m2 found net feedback ~ +0.5-1.5%.

accel_D.source: Automation speed-up per unit permissionless share (cheaper AI).

D0_spend.source: Permissionless share of AI spend 2026: DePIN ~$200-300M vs AI infra spend (Messari, blockeden); Bittensor verified revenue $3-45M/yr (Pine Analytics). Converted to workload share via prices.

r_open.source: Open-weight (centrally hosted) price relative to closed frontier, 3-10x cheaper (OpenRouter/a16z).

r0.source: Unsubsidized permissionless / centralized-hosting cost ratio for the same model, 2.3 (1.6-3.5), Pine.

r_floor.source: Structural permissionless relative cost at scale; judgement.

learning_rate.source: Cost drop per doubling of D (Wright's law; Way et al. 2022).

g_rel.source: Exogenous relative cost drift per year; judgement.

M_growth.source: Annual AI spend growth at full demand; Epoch trends.

m_dem.source: Reduction of AI spend growth per unit uncompensated exclusion (demand link).

open_lag_months.source: Open-weight lag 3-12 months (Epoch open-closed ECI gap).

quality_per_month.source: Price-equivalent quality penalty per month of lag; judgement.

h_open_stop.source: Hazard/yr that leading labs stop releasing weights (m3 research).

decentral_train_lag_months.source: If open releases stop: permissionless training ~1000x compute behind, 3-5 y (Covenant-72B arXiv 2603.08163).

anchor_share.source: Non-closed (open-weight) workload share at the 2025-26 price gap: Menlo 2025 enterprise 11% (19% in 2024), OpenRouter 33% of tokens (developer-skewed). Revealed preference; anchors f_med.

sigma_f.source: Dispersion of buyer friction (log units); judgement, heterogeneous niches.

g_fric.source: Friction drift per year (tooling maturation vs enterprise share falling 2024->25); judgement.

frontier_part.source: Part of friction that is frontier-capability demand (decays under plateau).

squeeze.source: Friction reduction per unit uncompensated exclusion (squeezed firms).

perm_fric0.source: Permissionless-specific friction at tiny scale (privacy to anonymous nodes, SLAs, compliance), price units; falls with network size.

D_crit.source: Network size at which permissionless friction falls by 1/e; judgement.

lambda_firm.source: Firm-level loss aversion on permissionless friction only (B2B procurement; individual TK lambda ~2 not applied).

anger.source: Protest migration per unit markup (Mastodon retention ~30%).

beta_split.source: Logit sensitivity of permissionless vs open-centralized split.

niche0.source: Niche workload using permissionless regardless (censorship-resistant, sanctioned jurisdictions, privacy, batch); judgement.

h_tip.source: Hazard/yr of a large player (state, consortium) unilaterally adopting.

tip_size.source: Workload added by a tipping event.

par_ai.source: Permissionless workload per unit parallel-economy participation.

bass_p.source: Bass innovation coef (Sultan, Farley & Lehmann 1990: mean 0.03).

bass_q.source: Bass imitation coef (Sultan et al. 1990: mean 0.38).

churn.source: Annual churn toward lower target (BitTorrent -90%, TorrentFreak).

kappa_O.source: Adjustment speed of open-centralized share per year.

selfhost.source: Share of open-weight workload self-hosted / off top-N providers.

p_coopt.source: P(incumbents co-opt the protocol so markups persist after B), AWS-on-Linux.

reward_share.source: Share of permissionless spend paid out as network rewards.

reward_breadth.source: Share of rewards reaching excluded workers (vs capital holders).

p_conc.source: P(tight oligopoly with pricing power): m3 research.

markup_max.source: Extractable markup if concentrated (Nvidia ~75% GM, AWS ~35% OM).

oms.source: Share of markup passed to open-weight hosting (runs on concentrated compute).

A_conc.source: Automation level at which dependence lets providers raise prices.

incumbent_response.source: Share of markup given up as D reaches ~10% (limit pricing).

p_state_support.source: P(material public/open AI subsidy, EU/Swiss Apertus/India).

state_support_cut.source: Open-weight cost cut from public support (NOT permissionless).

D_threat.source: Share at which states see permissionless AI as a threat.

crack_rate.source: Annual crackdown prob at full rentier dependence (Tornado Cash).

crack_eff.source: Share of D removed by crackdown (China mining 34%->0->14-20%).

crack_friction.source: Permanent permissionless friction added after crackdown.

exposure.source: Workforce share in automatable categories (Eloundou et al. 2023).

displace.source: Job loss per unit task automation (reinstatement/price-elasticity effects, Acemoglu & Restrepo 2019).

new_jobs.source: Share of lost jobs recreated early (Autor et al. 2024).

nj_decay.source: How much new-job creation shrinks as A->1.

domino_mult.source: B2B/second-round job loss per unit uncompensated demand loss.

b2b_lag.source: Years of B2B runway before client demand loss hits (user's S2).

p_ubi.source: P(substantial income replacement); m2: P(large transfer by 2060)=0.63.

ubi_erosion.source: Annual erosion of coverage (rentier state logic).

join.source: Share of uncompensated excluded who join; trueque 2002 (IPS).

loss_domain.source: Extra risk seeking in loss domain per unit (lambda-1).

currency_form.source: Share of parallel activity in a distinct AI-excluding system.

kappa.source: Adjustment speed of participation per year.

p_inst.source: P(parallel economy is institutionalised, WIR-like) vs trueque-like.

h_trueque.source: Collapse hazard/yr, crisis-grown weakly governed (trueque -85% in ~1y).

local_own.source: Share of land/energy/means held by the public outside elite control.

enclosure.source: Fraction of the rest enclosed by the automated elite as A->1.

open_boost.source: Parallel-economy productivity boost from local open/decentralized models.

V_res.source: Elite value of land/energy held by parallel economy (per unit P).

V_tax.source: Value of formal tax base eroded (per unit P).

C_legit.source: Legitimacy cost under full democratic accountability.

C_valve.source: Safety-valve value per unit E, scaled by (1-A) (S4: unrest stops mattering).

ai_tax_share_max.source: AI-firm share of tax base at full automation (rentier).

h_supp_max.source: Max annual suppression prob; calibrated so formed parallel economies face ~0.5-0.7 suppression within a decade (m7 research).

supp_eff.source: Share removed by suppression before automation (China ban, Woergl).

supp_join_cut.source: Permanent cut in join propensity after suppression (legal risk).
